turn.user_message: What exactly does our IT team need?
turn.context: Playbook §7: lead with one plain question about their systems, and keep the technical detail optional.

text: One question first, before any list. The answer decides what your IT team has to link.

question.text: Are billing and doctors’ notes kept in the same hospital software?
options: Some notes are still on paper

chat.pointer: The helper shows what it would ask your IT team. The detail is there if you want it.
chat.note: One question now. The rest can wait.
prompts: Yes, one system. Reports are separate.
This is too technical for now
I’d need to check with our IT team

blocks.title: One question before any list
blocks.deck: What Tojo would ask your IT team, in plain words. The detail is optional.

says.plain: One question for you first. Then four simple things for your IT team.
says.detail: Here is the detail, for whoever looks after your systems. None of it is needed today.

plain: Who looks after the hospital software
Whether Tojo can read records without changing them
How reports reach the doctors today
A test copy with the patient names hidden

detail.ask: Read-only access to billing and notes
detail.why: Tojo only reads. Nothing can be changed or deleted.

detail.ask: A copy of each report when it is signed off
detail.why: So the summary never waits for a report.

detail.ask: The list of charges and their prices
detail.why: So the bill can be kept up to date.

detail.ask: A test copy of one ward’s records
detail.why: So we can try it before any real patient.

detail.ask: One named person in your IT team
detail.why: One contact, so questions do not wait.

blocks.park: Anything more technical can wait. Say so, and Tojo will park it until you are ready.
